svg.style: background-color: #ffffff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
svg.text: Relational Database Schema Diagram with Referential Integrity Constraints
Tatkal High-Concurrency Reservation Engine • Elmasri & Navathe Notation (Arrows originate at Foreign Key and point to referenced Primary Key)

g.text: Diagram Legend & Referential Integrity Rules (Elmasri & Navathe Convention)
• Table Boxes: Each horizontal block represents a base relation in Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF).
• Primary Key (PK): Attribute name has a solid underline. Composite keys (e.g., TRAIN_STOP[train_id, stop_seq]) have all component attributes underlined.
• Foreign Key (FK) Arrows: Directed arrows originate from the child relation's Foreign Key attribute and point directly to the parent relation's referenced Primary Key.
Train Route & Rolling Stock: FK referencing TRAIN(train_id) with ON DELETE CASCADE
Station Halts & Corridors: FK referencing STATION(station_id) with ON DELETE RESTRICT
User Reservations: FK referencing APP_USER(user_id) with ON DELETE RESTRICT
Calendar Train Runs: FK referencing TRAIN_RUN(run_id) with ON DELETE CASCADE
Passenger Ticket Booking: FK referencing BOOKING(pnr) with ON DELETE CASCADE
Seat & Coach Topology: FK referencing COACH(coach_id) / SEAT(seat_id)
